column1: # K-Line Dash: generic powertrain, network and shared trouble code descriptions
# Source: SAE J2012 / ISO 15031-6 generic (non-manufacturer-specific) definitions, in the
# standard English wording style. These are the generic meanings only; a manufacturer may
# add its own detail. Format: CODE<TAB>description. Lines starting with # are comments.
# Only codes whose generic wording is well established are listed; a code missing here is
# unknown to the app, not invalid. Not covered on purpose: P08xx-P09xx beyond the few
# clutch/park-neutral switch codes, P0660-P0684, and manufacturer-defined ranges.
